title: Separate complex-graph dissipation from the unsigned chemical-weight remainder
statement: Choose a positive stationary weight a on the finite strongly connected complex graph and write f_rho(y)=a_y*h_rho(y)>0. Then sum_{s->t} kappa_st f_s log(f_t/f_s)=sum kappa_st a_s h_s log(h_t/h_s)+sum kappa_st f_s log(a_t/a_s). The first sum is <=0 by log u<=u-1 and complex stationarity; the second has no fixed sign. If a_y is compatible with a common chemical c^y it can be absorbed into the familiar complex-balanced product-Poisson entropy. Weak reversibility alone does not pay this compatibility. This is an exact finite positive-weight algebraic split; the infinite-state stochastic entropy differentiation still needs its own justification.
